density.S: volume share here at or above 0.042 — structure under price
density.V: volume share here below 0.042 — thinner than a flat profile

escape.d: barrier up / down > 1.50 — less structure below
escape.u: barrier up / down < 0.67 — less structure above

position.D: deeper than 2.0 ATR below the volume mode
position.E: within 0.5 ATR of the mode — at equilibrium
position.F: further than 2.0 ATR above the mode

cuts.density_reference_is: the share a UNIFORM profile puts in one bin — a reference point, not a threshold fitted to the sample

not_written_to: the DuckDB bars table — single-writer rule
outcome_touched: none. This is a description of a bar, not a claim about it.
why_only_landscape: stage 2.5 found decl_M re-encoded by the nine lines at OOS R² 0.857 and decl_K at 0.586; stage 2 found no law-like invariant anywhere and decl_R to be a size proxy. The landscape is the one description the alphabet does not already carry.
